name: inv-6-one-red-then-green-era-test
description: Whether a TaskGraph is I6-era (red-then-green owed when new tests are required) is decided only by redThenGreenEra(frozenManifest) in engine/src/core/proof-obligations.ts. Population, the state-file-wire obligation-match check and task revalidation call it directly, and settlement and the stored-evidence reconcile reach it through redThenGreenDuty (implementation-application.ts), so they cannot disagree about which graphs owe I6 (G4 slice 2, FR-005, FR-010). This rule refuses an inline presence test on the frozen manifest's testFiles field anywhere else; verification-manifest.ts is excluded because it parses and freezes that field.
fixHint: Call redThenGreenEra(graph.verification_manifest) from engine/src/core/proof-obligations.ts instead of testing testFiles presence inline.
